description: This file is a Perl script that generates ARM assembly code for AES encryption/decryption routines optimized for ARMv8 architecture, supporting both 32-bit and 64-bit modes, with specific routines for key setup, block encryption/decryption, and CBC/CTR modes. It includes inline assembly code and architecture-specific optimizations.

methods.name: aes_hw_set_encrypt_key
methods.description: Generates encryption key schedule for AES.

methods.name: aes_hw_set_decrypt_key
methods.description: Generates decryption key schedule for AES.

methods.name: aes_hw_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
methods.description: Performs AES CTR mode encryption on multiple blocks.
